editorial:
You know that feeling when a movie just grabs you from the first scene and never lets go? That is exactly what happens here. A tough but good-hearted taxi driver picks up two strange teenagers who turn out to be aliens with superpowers. Before he can even process what is going on, government agents and a scary alien assassin are chasing them across the desert. The story moves fast, the action scenes are fun, and there is a nice mix of humor and heart that keeps things light even when the danger ramps up. The kids are charming, and the lead actor brings his usual big-screen energy to every scene.

The pacing rarely slows down, which is great if you want an easy, exciting watch. The special effects hold up well, and the family-friendly tone means you can enjoy it with kids without worrying about anything too intense. On the downside, the plot is pretty predictable, and some characters feel a bit one-note. Still, it is a solid pick for a movie night. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the taxi driver helps the alien teens reach Witch Mountain, where their spaceship is hidden. They activate the ship and prepare to leave Earth. The scary alien assassin attacks one last time, but the teens use their powers to defeat him. The government agents arrive but stand down after seeing the truth. The teens say goodbye to their new friend and fly home, promising to return someday. The driver watches them go, changed by the adventure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventure movies with aliens and action.
